remarks: Light, space and convenience define this townhouse in award winning Middlesex Commons- adjacent to Whole Foods and a short walk to the Darien Metro North station. The foyer, with custom cabinetry and bookshelves, leads to an open living/dining room with soaring two story windows, a fireplace, and sliders to a private west facing deck overlooking landscaped open space. The eat-in kitchen enjoys bright southeastern light throughout the morning. The primary bedroom features a cathedral ceiling with skylight, a spacious bath with tub and shower, and a private balcony. A second bedroom also offers a cathedral ceiling and skylight as well as a full bath. An office nook sits at the top of the graceful, curved staircase. A detached one car garage and plentiful parking accompany the home. The beautifully maintained ten-acre grounds include sweeping lawns, a pond, a saltwater, heated pool, pool house and a charming guest cottage for visitors. Restaurants, shops, drug stores, boutiques and the Darien Library are all within an easy walk.
